caption: Training curves on the synthetic dataset. We refer our readers to Figure <ref> in Appendix <ref> for a visualization of the synthetic dataset.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the training accuracy over epochs for three different parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods on a synthetic dataset: C³A_b=128/2 (magenta line with circular markers), LoRA_r=1 (gray line with circular markers), and Linear (solid blue line). The x-axis, labeled “Epoch,” ranges from 0 to 400 with linear spacing and tick marks every 50 epochs. The y-axis, labeled “Training Accuracy,” ranges from 0.0 to 1.0 with linear spacing and tick marks every 0.2. The Linear method rapidly converges to near-perfect accuracy (≈0.99) by epoch 50 and remains stable thereafter. The C³A_b=128/2 method also converges quickly, reaching approximately 0.95 by epoch 50 and stabilizing with minor fluctuations. In contrast, LoRA_r=1 starts with lower accuracy, exhibits more volatility in early epochs, and gradually increases to about 0.85 by epoch 400, showing slower convergence and higher variance throughout training. All three lines are plotted with circular markers and solid line styles, with the legend positioned in the lower-right corner.
